changeSet.author: cold-storage-monitoring-audit
changeSet.comment: Modbus register decoding was hardcoded to exactly one 16-bit signed register, but real-world devices vary in register width and byte/word order (e.g. a DIY ESP32+DS18B20 Modbus slave, issue #3743). Adds per-freezer register_count/word_order configuration, defaulting to the prior hardcoded behavior (1 register, big-endian) so existing configured devices are unaffected. Also adds RS-485 half-duplex driver-enable timing fields (off by default) wired to digitalpetri modbus-serial 2.1.5's SerialPortTransportConfig rs485* fields, per the Modbus-over-Serial-Line spec's RS-485 turnaround timing requirements cited in issue #3743.
